turns.text: Lloyd, the build for ReMEmbR failed. It's still using the old flat point cloud structure, right? I need to revert the config to `--representation=flat` to match the current codebase.
Understood. I will update the build configuration to use `--representation=flat`. Did you also check the dependency logs?
Yes, it's fine. Oh, did the package for my new mechanical keyboard arrive? The one with the brown switches?
I don't have access to real-time shipping info, but I can remind you to check your email. Have you tried a different shipping carrier?
No, just waiting. Anyway, fix the build. Keep the flat structure for now until I figure out the migration.
Done. The config is set to flat representation.
Lloyd, huge news. We finally migrated ReMEmbR. It now builds persistent 3D scene graphs with rich semantic descriptions. No more flat clouds.
That's a major upgrade. The semantic layer will definitely help with the retrieval tasks we discussed earlier.
Exactly. By the way, did you see that storm warning for tomorrow? I might work from home.
I saw it. Working from home might be safer if the power lines are affected. Do you need me to adjust your calendar?
Not yet. Let's focus on the ReMEmbR update. I need to run a demo of the new architecture.
Sure. I'll prepare the demo environment for the new scene graph version.
